name: wineauction
description: Check wine prices against retail and auction references, find deals in live auctions, and watch wines or regions for good offers, using WineAuction data.

interface.shortDescription: Check wine prices and find auction deals
interface.longDescription: Judge wine prices from a merchant email, price list or restaurant wine list against retail and auction references, find the best-value lots in live auctions, and watch wines, producers or regions for good offers. Read-only: it cannot bid, buy or contact anyone.
